definitions.gloss: bad guy; villain; the bad party
definitions.explanation: A villain or wrongdoer, contrasted with a hero. Also used for whoever or whatever is cast as the cause of a problem.
In health and nutrition, bacteria that harm the body, especially in the gut. Usually said as 悪玉菌.

examples.japanese: {悪玉|あくだま}が{捕|つか}まる。
ドラマでは{彼|かれ}がいつも{悪玉|あくだま}{役|やく}だ。
examples.english: In dramas he always plays the villain.

examples.japanese: {一人|ひとり}を{悪玉|あくだま}にして{済|す}ませるのは{公平|こうへい}ではない。
examples.english: It is not fair to settle things by making one person the villain.

examples.japanese: {悪玉菌|あくだまきん}が{増|ふ}える。
{脂|あぶら}っこい{食事|しょくじ}は{悪玉|あくだま}コレステロールを{増|ふ}やす。
{腸内|ちょうない}で{悪玉菌|あくだまきん}が{優勢|ゆうせい}になると、{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}しやすくなる。
examples.english: When bad bacteria dominate the gut, you become more prone to feeling unwell.

notes:
Compound of {悪|あく} (bad, evil) + {玉|だま} (ball; figuratively a person or thing). The opposite is {善玉|ぜんだま}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪玉|あくだま}{役|やく}: villain role
- {悪玉菌|あくだまきん}: bad (harmful) bacteria
- {悪玉|あくだま}コレステロール: LDL ('bad') cholesterol

USAGE:
- Sense 1 has a storybook, melodrama flavor.
- Sense 2 (悪玉菌, 悪玉コレステロール) is common in everyday health talk.
